scores.method: Editorial heuristics, not Google scores. Content/on-page site scores are rounded equal-page means. On-page scope excludes technical SEO and performance.

findings.title: Benchmark labels omit judged-candidate filtering and aggregate-query scope
findings.observed: P@4 prose says first four results; calculation takes first four after judged-only filtering. Cards beneath the active query show seven-query aggregate percentages while images show unrestricted neighbors. Values are explainable; fabrication is not alleged.
findings.smallestChange: Qualify first four judged candidates and averages across seven queries, or use clearly labeled query-specific metrics. Distinguish the dated benchmark snapshot from live archive size.
findings.dependency: Owner confirmation of intended evaluation definition; no model change needed to correct wording.
findings.verification: Trace two selected queries to queries[].precisionAtK and model.metrics.precisionAtK; explain candidate set and which value remains constant.
findings.indicator: Zero unexplained metric/legend mismatches across seven query selections.

findings.title: Project contribution and ownership remain inferred
findings.observed: Portfolio and focus details show artifacts, summaries and stack but not verified responsibility/results. Photo Graph has first-person testing evidence but does not delimit design/implementation/photography ownership. Catalog TBD fields are not public placeholders.
findings.smallestChange: One concise visible professional-role line and owner-approved contribution/result context in existing project copy/shared catalog. Do not invent numeric outcomes or add a blog.
findings.dependency: Owner confirmation of credits, collaborators, image ownership and supported outcomes.
findings.verification: A first-time reviewer can identify who built what, Dexter's part and a supported result without opening a PDF.
findings.indicator: Five of five displayed projects have verified contribution context; monitor existing project/contact/resume engagement cautiously.

findings.title: Installer trust context is indirect
findings.observed: Landing links official Store and domain but has no named maker or direct support/privacy signposting. Store does provide matching domain/email and a developer privacy disclosure; ecosystem absence or violation is not alleged.
findings.smallestChange: Compact maker/support/privacy line linking existing canonical disclosures; clarify affiliation using approved facts.
findings.dependency: Verify current extension disclosures; distinguish extension data handling from landing-page analytics.
findings.verification: Follow links without installing and compare identity/contact/disclosures with current Store and behavior.
findings.indicator: Maker, support and privacy discoverable from landing in one action with consistent contact.

findings.title: Metadata presents demos before the installable Chrome extension
findings.observed: Title lists features without product category; description leads Explore live demos while visible page is install-oriented. Metadata is unique and not templated; no rigid length failure.
findings.smallestChange: Lead existing metadata with Chrome extension and main benefit, preserving brand/features and only verified free-use claims.
findings.dependency: Owner-approved positioning and availability; demo verification.
findings.verification: Raw/rendered metadata agree and accurately explain what gets installed; Search Console may falsify an assumed intent gap.
findings.indicator: Feature/branded query CTR and existing landing-to-Store clicks versus baseline and channel mix; no causal ranking claim.

findings.title: Comparison-image alternatives do not describe visual evidence
findings.observed: Rank N, photo ID repeats adjacent caption without subject/tone/palette. Query-thumbnail empty alt is appropriate with adjacent label; portfolio poster alts are purposeful.
findings.smallestChange: Human-reviewed subject/colour descriptions for finite comparison set, keyed by image ID; preserve quiet decorative thumbnails.
findings.dependency: Curated descriptions; no descriptive GraphNode field currently exists. No database migration assumed.
findings.verification: Screen reader/images-off review can explain similarity evidence beyond numeric IDs.
findings.indicator: All informative comparison images have accurate alternatives, with duplicate/decorative images kept quiet.

observationsNotConfirmedDefects.observed: Isolated Chrome displayed temporarily unavailable demo fallback for overview/market compare; initial forced renderer saw connecting/lazy states.
observationsNotConfirmedDefects.nextStep: Technical owner should reproduce in ordinary clean browser before calling persistent outage. If persistent restore proof or provide truthful static fallback. No performance measurement or root cause claim.

limitations: No Search Console, rankings, traffic, conversion, backlinks or broad reputation data.
LinkedIn public fetch returned 999; GitHub/Store corroborate identity/published product, not independent endorsement.
No extension install, permissions/data-behavior audit, credential inspection or production database access.
DOM innerText can include clipped desktop summaries. Mobile summaries require focus view; modal/focus-only content was not presented as default SSR copy.
Readability numbers use approximate syllable heuristics and extraction artifacts; no word-count minimum applied. Automated thin-content flags rejected for these page types.
Actual small-screen DOM viewport was 500px, not requested 375px; no exact 375px test claim.
